annotation.title_clean: Study on an Operation Regulation Framework under International Humanitarian Law for Sentry Robots
annotation.title_en: Study on an Operation Regulation Framework under International Humanitarian Law for Sentry Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Tsujita, T.; Sakuma, Y.; Yamada, S.; Eto, R.; Kurosaki, M.
annotation.venue: Journal of the Robotics Society of Japan (JRSJ) Vol. 40 No. 7
annotation.summary_en: Japanese robotics journal article interpreting international humanitarian law (Additional Protocol I) to propose an operation regulation framework for sentry robots protecting civilians from suicide bombings. It derives legal indicators (certainty, effort, nexus possibility, necessity, collateral damage) from distinction, proportionality and precaution, validated with a real robot.
key_provisions_or_claims: Interprets IHL articles to define requirements for sentry robot systems.
Maps distinction, proportionality and precaution principles to computable legal indicators.
Indicators: certainty, effort, nexus possibility, necessity, collateral damage.
Framework validated experimentally with a real robot.
Engages with LAWS debate under the CCW GGE.
